source: The Fantasy Arsenal local walk-forward trainer
target: weekly PPR points relative to a leakage-safe rolling player baseline

validation.method: Tune architecture and shrinkage before 2025; allow advanced-context challengers; promote each position only after a strict untouched 2025 incumbent MAE/RMSE gate; refit promoted architectures on all saved seasons.

promotion.rule: Lower 2025 MAE than incumbent by at least 0.01, improve 2025 RMSE by at least 0.001, and lower MAE than the neutral baseline. Live release audits additionally reject unstable forecast distributions.
